title: Expansion of the locally closed pairing equation
statement: For finite commutative rings A,B, an open j followed by a closed g, objects L,M, and an isomorphism b between the scalar extension of the exceptional object and the exceptional scalar extension, any PairingChangeEquation expands to the explicit categorical equality consisting of ordinaryComparison, the mapped evaluation and b.hom, internalAdjunction, and the mapped compactComparison, equal to scalar extension of internalAdjunction followed by evaluationComparison.

source.place: Proof paragraph 4, expansion and reassociation of PairingChangeEquation

proof.text: Unfold PairingChangeEquation. The defining equality is the displayed composite with the map of the composite evaluation and exceptional comparison. Reassociate the composite and use functoriality of the star functor to write the map of the composite as the displayed categorical word.

proof_origin.place: Proof paragraph 4, expansion and reassociation of PairingChangeEquation

lean.statement:
theorem pairingEquation_expanded
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    {S Z X : Scheme.{u}} (φ : A →+* B) (g : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion g]
    (j : S ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (L : DerivedCategoryModule A S) (M : DerivedCategoryModule A X)
    (b : (scalarExtension φ S).obj ((exceptional A g j).obj M) ≅
      (exceptional B g j).obj ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M))
    (hp : PairingChangeEquation φ g j L M b) :
    ordinaryComparison φ g j
        (((derivedHom (ModuleCat A) S).obj (op L)).obj ((exceptional A g j).obj M)) ≫
      (star B g j).map
        (evaluationComparison φ S L ((exceptional A g j).obj M) ≫
          ((derivedHom (ModuleCat B) S).obj
            (op ((scalarExtension φ S).obj L))).map b.hom) ≫
      internalAdjunction B g j ((scalarExtension φ S).obj L) ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M) ≫
      ((derivedHom (ModuleCat B) X).map (compactComparison φ g j L).op).app
        ((scalarExtension φ X).obj M) =
    (scalarExtension φ X).map (internalAdjunction A g j L M) ≫
      evaluationComparison φ X ((shriek A g j).obj L) M
